texts.value: Component of the telomerase ribonucleoprotein complex that is essential for the replication of chromosome termini (PubMed:19179534). Component of the vault particle, which is a massive ribonucleoprotein complex that may play a role in cargo transport and signal transduction (By similarity). Responsible for the localizing and stabilizing vault RNA (vRNA) association in the vault ribonucleoprotein particle. Binds to TERC (By similarity)

Associates with MVP to form part of the vault particle (By similarity). The vault is a massive cage-like structure; it consists of a dimer of half-vaults, with each half-vault comprising 39 identical MVP subunits (By similarity). The two half-vaults assemble to form the complete vault, where minor vault components such as PARP4, TEP1 and vault RNAs (vRNAs) may bind to the interior (By similarity). Binds to VAULTRC1, VAULTRC2 and VAULTRC4/hvg4 vRNAs (By similarity)
May be due to an exon inclusion
